Have your own database?
Store memory in your database, then layer on our secure hosted capabilities for semantic search, graph relationships, monitoring, and third-party integrations for bi-directional enrichment.
Security, access, and data controls
Role-based access control (RBAC)
Every memory operation respects the permissions defined in your database. Assign roles for read, write, and admin access, or map directly to your existing roles and policies. Integrate with your identity providers (SSO, OAuth) to centrally manage permissions.
Data retention and deletion
Define how long memories persist per namespace or user. Apply different retention windows for short-term and long-term data. Expired records are automatically purged with a full audit trail of what was removed.
Audit and observability
Every retrieval includes metadata on who accessed what, when, and why. Run queries to reconstruct memory access events over time.
Data ownership
Your data stays in your database. Memori never moves, stores or indexes data outside your chosen environment unless you explicitly enable our Memori Cloud.
